article: Compliance communications
stem: A chief compliance officer encounters employees who cannot explain how an ethics policy applies to their daily work. What is the MOST appropriate next step?

Use clear, accessible, role-relevant guidance with examples and measure whether employees understand it.
Publish a longer policy with more technical legal terminology.
